description: This file defines an abstract class ByteWriter in the namespace firebolt::rialto::common, which provides virtual methods for writing bytes, integers, and strings into a buffer. It serves as an interface for byte writing operations, likely to be implemented by concrete classes.

classes.name: ByteWriter
classes.description: An abstract class providing virtual methods for writing various data types into a byte buffer.

methods.name: writeByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte to the buffer at a specified offset.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes multiple bytes to the buffer starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: fillBytes
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a specified byte for a given count starting at an offset.

methods.name: writeUint32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: writeInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit signed integer to the buffer.

methods.name: writeCString
methods.description: Writes a null-terminated C string to the buffer.
